jobs.title: IT Cybersecurity Operations Manager
jobs.description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.

Group/Division
KLA's IT group supports business growth and productivity by connecting people, process and technology around the world. We work to improve the technology that drives our business to thrive and focus on empowering employee use of technology. This integrated approach to customer service, creativity and technological excellence enhances employee productivity, business analytics and process excellence.

What You'll Do
In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.

We are seeking a, IT Cybersecurity Operations Manager to lead the strategy, deployment, and operations of endpoint security technologies across the enterprise. This role owns the endpoint security toolset end-to-end — from architecture and implementation to daily operations and continuous improvement — while managing a team of engineers and partnering closely with SOC, IT, and infrastructure teams. This role combines hands-on technical leadership with people and program management, ensuring endpoints are protected against modern threats while maintaining usability and business productivity.

Endpoint Security & Tools Ownership
- Own and manage enterprise endpoint security platforms including EDR/XDR, endpoint protection, device control, DLP and endpoint privilege management agents .

- Lead the design, deployment, configuration, and optimization of endpoint security tools across Windows, macOS, and Linux environments.

- Ensure endpoint security tools integrate effectively with SIEM, SOAR, SOC workflows , and identity platforms.

- Define endpoint hardening standards, baselines, and security policies.

Operations & Incident Response
- Oversee endpoint-related security incidents, investigations, and remediation efforts.

- Partner with SOC teams to improve detection, response, and automation related to endpoint threats.

- Manage tool health, agent performance, upgrades, and lifecycle management.

- Drive root cause analysis and continuous improvement following incidents.

People & Program Management
- Lead, mentor, and develop a team of endpoint security engineers.

- Prioritize work, manage roadmaps, and track delivery of endpoint security initiatives.

- Establish operational processes, documentation, and KPIs for endpoint security tooling.

- Manage vendor relationships, licensing, and renewals.

Strategy & Stakeholder Collaboration
- Define the security agents roadmap  aligned with Zero Trust and defense-in-depth strategies.

- Partner with Cybersecurity, IT operations, desktop engineering, IAM, and compliance teams to balance security and user experience.

- Evaluate new endpoint security technologies and lead POCs and rollouts.

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience integrating endpoint tools with SIEM/SOAR  platforms (Elastic, Google SecOps, etc.).

- Familiarity with MDM/MAM  solutions (Intune, JAMF, Workspace ONE).

- Experience in regulated or large enterprise environments.

- Certifications such as CISSP, GCED, GCIA , SentinelOne, Proofpoint, or CyberArk certifications .

Minimum Qualifications
Required Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or related field (or equivalent experience).

- 10+ years of experience in endpoint security or endpoint engineering , with 4+ years in a lead or management role .

- Strong hands-on experience with one or more endpoint security platforms such as:
- EDR : SentinelOne, CrowdStrike, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, Carbon Black

- DLP: Forcepoint, Proofpoint and Digital Guardian

- EPM: CyberArk, Beyond Trust

- Experience managing enterprise endpoint environments (Windows/macOS; Linux a plus).

- Solid understanding of endpoint attack techniques and MITRE ATT&CK.

About KLA
We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.

Total Rewards
Base Pay Range: $114,100.00 - $167,367.00 Annually
Primary Location: USA-MI-Ann Arbor-KLA

jobs.title: Regional Trade Compliance Program Manager
jobs.description:
Company Overview

KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us.

Group/Division

The Legal Compliance Organization (LCO) team headquartered in Milpitas, CA and second headquarters in Ann Arbor, MI provides legal guidance to further KLA’s strategic objectives and protect and preserve the legal, ethical and financial integrity and reputation of the Company. With specific expertise in the areas of corporate law, commercial law, employment law, and intellectual property; the LCO offers strategic legal counsel that is informed by a clear understanding of the company’s business objectives and expertise in the laws and regulations relevant to the business worldwide.

Job Description/Preferred Qualifications
KLA Corporation is seeking a highly motivated teammate to serve as the EMEA lead within the Global Trade Compliance (GTC) team and as the primary Ethics & Compliance partner for Israel. The individual will use their expertise to serve as the regional lead for global trade compliance matters across EMEA — supervising EU, UK, and Israel regulatory developments and leading the regional export licensing program — while also serving as the on-the-ground Ethics & Compliance presence for KLA's Israel operations. In this capacity, the role will conduct internal investigations, deliver training, advise on conflicts of interest matters, and generally be seen and serve as the primary Ethics & Compliance person for Israel. The individual will collaborate with internal and external corporate partners to lead programs that support the company's trade compliance and ethics & compliance efforts in the region.
Since the person in this role will represent both GTC and the Ethics & Compliance function in high visibility projects with multi-disciplinary teams, we are looking for someone who has strong trade compliance and licensing knowledge, sound judgment on ethics and compliance issues, can communicate effectively, and possesses excellent project management skills to drive initiatives to completion. An ability to work comfortably across global geographies and a passion for compliance are key for this position.
The position will report into the Director of Global Trade Compliance in the US and will be based in Israel.

Trade Compliance responsibilities will include, but will not be limited to:
- Serve as the EMEA regional lead for global trade compliance matters, representing GTC and managing team members across the region
- Research local and regional trade regulations and rulings for: HS, ECCN/Export Classification, Country of Origin, import/export documentation requirements and valuation of products
- Lead regional import/export classification efforts; oversee EU, UK and Israel export license process
- Work with regional teams to review impact of annual import/export regulatory changes upon company technology
- Liaise with local Customs Authorities and other Governmental Agencies as required
- Provide guidance to regional teams on daily operational activities and recordkeeping
- Lead regional import/export compliance awareness training; develop and implement standardized trade compliance processes and procedures
- Support regional Denied Parties screening efforts as required
- Perform internal import/export audits, report on results and drive remedial actions to resolution
- Drive continuous improvement, best practices and standardization for trade compliance programs
- Ensure reporting of key trade compliance matters and metrics to Trade Compliance management
- Act as a regional GTC liaison with cross-functional teams on regional corporate initiatives
- Drive completion of annual GTC objectives

Ethics & Compliance responsibilities (Israel) will include, but will not be limited to:
- Serve as the primary Ethics & Compliance point of contact for KLA's Israel operations, providing day-to-day guidance to local employees, managers, and leadership
- Conduct internal investigations into potential compliance concerns, including intake, fact-finding, documentation, and follow-through on remedial actions
- Develop and deliver ethics & compliance training tailored to the Israel workforce
- Advise on and help manage conflicts of interest matters, including disclosures, reviews, and mitigation
- Promote a culture of ethics and integrity, and serve as a visible, trusted resource for employees raising concerns
- Partner with Legal and other stakeholders to implement company-wide policies, programs, and initiatives locally

The successful candidate will possess the following:
- Solid knowledge of EU trade regulations is required; demonstrated work experience with Israel import/export regulations
- Experience with, or strong aptitude for, ethics & compliance matters — including investigations, training, and conflicts of interest
- Sound judgment, discretion, and the ability to handle sensitive and confidential matters with integrity
- Work experience in a semiconductor or high technology industry is helpful
- Ability to collaborate with multi-functional global teams and drive issues to conclusion
- Flexibility with changing priorities, as well as shifting regulatory and customer conditions
- Motivated self-starter; strong influencing and collaborating skills

Qualifications:
- 7-10 years of Global Trade Compliance experience; ethics & compliance experience a plus
- BS or BA degree
- Solid communication, project management and Powerpoint skills
- Proficiency using regional licensing portals, SAP/GTS systems and MS office tools
- Strong quantitative, analytical and critical thinking skills with a high attention to detail
- Self-starter and able to work with minimal direction
- Previous experience managing programs
- Ability to travel as needed
- Proficient in English; one EU language required; proficiency in Hebrew a plus

Minimum Qualifications
- 7-10 years of Global Trade Compliance experience; ethics & compliance experience a plus
- BS or BA degree
- Solid communication, project management and Powerpoint skills
- Proficiency using regional licensing portals, SAP/GTS systems and MS office tools
- Strong quantitative, analytical and critical thinking skills with a high attention to detail
- Self-starter and able to work with minimal direction
- Previous experience managing programs
- Ability to travel as needed
- Proficient in English; one EU language required; proficiency in Hebrew a plus

- Simplify, standardize, and automate logistics finance processes to improve efficiency, reporting quality, and scalability.

Data Analytics & Digital Insights (Preferred)
- Use Snowflake, Power BI, and other enterprise data platforms to analyze large and sophisticated datasets, identify trends, risks, and opportunities, and support business reporting and financial analysis.
- Build and maintain reporting datasets, dashboards, and management reporting solutions while partnering with Digital Solutions, Finance, and Operations teams to improve data quality and reporting capabilities.

- Support automation initiatives that streamline reporting, forecasting, and financial analysis processes.
- Support the adoption of AI tools and effective ways of working as part of the company's digital transformation efforts.

- Proven understanding of manufacturing warehousing operations, warehouse cost drivers, and logistics processes.

Experience with:
- Power BI
- Snowflake
- SAP
- Power Query
- OneStream, TM1, Essbase or other planning systems
- Experience building executive dashboards, financial models, and automated reporting solutions.
- Exposure to AI-enabled efficiency tools and process automation technologies.

Minimum Qualifications

- Minimum 5 years of experience in FP&A, manufacturing, warehousing, logistics finance, business operations, or a related analytical role.

jobs.title: Engineering Program Manager
jobs.description:
Company Overview

KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us.

Group/Division

The KLA Services team headquartered in Milpitas, CA is our service organization that consists of Service Sales and Marketing, Spares Supply Chain management, Field Operations, Engineering, Product Training, and Technical Support. The KLA Services organization partners with our field teams and customers in all business sectors to maintain the high performance and productivity of our products through a flexible portfolio of services. Our comprehensive services include: proactive management of tools to identify and improve performance; expertise in optics, image processing and motion control with worldwide service engineers, 24/7 technical support teams and knowledge management systems; and an extensive parts network to ensure worldwide availability of parts.

Job Description/Preferred Qualifications
Own the end-to-end program management of KLA's in-fab repair operations — ensuring repair activity is executed in full alignment with legal, trade compliance, procurement, logistics, and internal engineering processes. Act as the single accountable owner who stitches together cross-functional stakeholders (Legal, Trade Compliance, Procurement, Supply Chain, Logistics, Sustaining Engineering, Field Operations) to deliver timely, compliant, and well-documented in-fab repair outcomes. Drive process definition, documentation, and continuous improvement across the in-fab repair value chain.

Key Responsibilities
- Program ownership:  Lead the in-fab repair program end-to-end — scope, milestones, risks, dependencies, and deliverables — across all participating functions.
- Legal & compliance stewardship:  Partner with Legal and Trade Compliance to ensure every in-fab repair activity meets contractual, export control, customs, and regulatory requirements; own exception handling and escalation for compliance blockers.
- Procurement coordination:  Work with Procurement and Strategic Sourcing to drive supplier engagement, RFQs, POs, and contract execution in support of repair BOMs and tooling needs.
- Logistics management:  Orchestrate inbound/outbound logistics with Supply Chain and freight partners — parts movement to/from customer fabs, cross-border shipments, customs clearance, and repair return loops (RMA/loaner pools).
- Process definition & documentation:  Build, publish, and maintain the end-to-end in-fab repair process — SOPs, RACI, workflow diagrams, decision trees, and operating playbooks. Establish document control and version governance.
- ECO release management:  Own Engineering Change Order (ECO) release management for in-fab repair — from initiation and cross-functional review through approval, release, and field rollout; ensure changes are controlled, communicated, and implemented consistently across sites.
- Cross-functional governance:  Run the in-fab repair operating cadence — steering committee, weekly operations review, and issue-resolution forums; drive decisions and action closure with clear owners and dates.
- Risk & issue management:  Proactively identify program risks (legal, compliance, supply, logistics, technical, schedule); maintain risk register and drive mitigation plans.
- KPI & reporting:  Define and track program KPIs — cycle time, first-time-fix, compliance exception rate, logistics lead time, cost per repair; deliver executive-ready status updates.
- Continuous improvement:  Lead post-mortems and root-cause reviews on process failures; drive corrective and preventive actions back into the standard operating model.
- Stakeholder alignment:  Bridge engineering, field, and business stakeholders across regions (HQ, China, Singapore); translate priorities and constraints into clear program decisions.

Minimum Qualifications
- Bachelor's or Master's degree in  Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations Management, Business, or related discipline .
- 5+ years of program/project management experience in semiconductor capital equipment, high-tech manufacturing, or complex engineering operations — ideally at the intersection of engineering and business functions.
- Demonstrated experience managing  cross-functional programs  spanning legal, trade compliance, procurement, logistics, and engineering.
- Strong working knowledge of  export controls, trade compliance, and customs processes  as they apply to semiconductor tool parts and field service operations.
- Proven ability to  define, document, and govern enterprise processes  — SOPs, RACI, process maps, document control systems.
- Experience with  ECO (Engineering Change Order) release management  — initiation, review, approval, and field rollout within an engineering change-control framework.
- Excellent program management toolkit: schedule management, risk/issue registers, decision logs, status reporting, stage-gate reviews.
- Strong stakeholder management and executive communication — able to drive outcomes across functions and geographies without direct authority.
- Fluent written and spoken English; working proficiency in Mandarin strongly preferred for direct coordination with China field and customer teams.
- Eligible to work in Singapore.

Preferred Qualifications
- Prior experience in a semiconductor OEM service/sustaining organization managing in-fab or field repair programs.
- Technical background (Engineering degree and/or prior hands-on technical experience in semiconductor equipment, electronics, or opto-mechanical systems) is a plus.

jobs.title: Principal Cloud Operations Lead
jobs.description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.

Group/Division
KLA's IT group supports business growth and productivity by connecting people, process and technology around the world. We work to improve the technology that drives our business to thrive and focus on empowering employee use of technology. This integrated approach to customer service, creativity and technological excellence enhances employee productivity, business analytics and process excellence.

What You'll Do
In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.

We are seeking an experienced Principal Cloud Operations Lead to lead global cloud operations across Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) . This role is responsible for ensuring the reliability, security, performance, and operational excellence of the organization's cloud services while providing 24x7 support to a global user base.

Key Responsibilities

Cloud Operations Leadership

- Lead and manage global cloud operations across AWS, Azure, and GCP

- Develop and execute cloud operational strategies aligned with business objectives

- Ensure high availability, reliability, and performance of cloud platforms

- Provide executive reporting on cloud health, service availability, operational metrics, and risks

- Manage a globally distributed cloud operations team and follow-the-sun support model.

Service Delivery & Support

- Provide Tier 2 and Tier 3 operational support for cloud infrastructure and platform services.

- Establish and manage 24x7 on-call support processes.

- Drive major incident management and root cause analysis.

- Develop SLAs, OLAs, KPIs, and operational dashboards.

- Ensure timely resolution of service requests, incidents, and problems.

Cloud Governance & Security

- Partner with Information Security teams to enforce security standards, policies, and compliance requirements.

- Ensure cloud environments meet regulatory and audit requirements.

- Implement security best practices including:

- Identity & Access Management (IAM)

- Privileged Access Management (PAM)

- Network Security

- Data Protection

- Encryption

- Vulnerability Management

- Standardize cloud operational processes across AWS, Azure, and GCP.

- Maintain cloud operating models.

Monitoring & Observability

- Implement enterprise monitoring and observability frameworks.

- Develop proactive alerting and performance optimization strategies.

Disaster Recovery & Business Continuity

- Define cloud DR strategies, RTO/RPO objectives, and recovery procedures.

- Conduct DR testing and business continuity exercises.

- Oversee backup and recovery operations for cloud workloads.

Cost & Capacity Management

- Manage cloud financial operations (FinOps).

- Optimize cloud spending across AWS, Azure, and GCP.

- Monitor utilization , capacity, rightsizing, and reservation strategies.

- Drive cost governance and budget planning.

Minimum Qualifications
-
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science , Information Technology, Engineering, or related field.   Master's degree preferred.

- 10+ years of IT Infrastructure, Cloud Operations, or Platform Engineering experience.

- 5+ years in management or leadership role .

- Experience managing global cloud operations teams supporting enterprise environments.

- Hands-on experience operating AWS, Azure, and GCP production environments.

About KLA
We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.

jobs.title: Technical project and program manager
jobs.description:
Company Overview
KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us.

Group/Division
With over 40 years of semiconductor process control experience, chipmakers around the globe rely on KLA to ensure that their fabs ramp next-generation devices to volume production quickly and cost-effectively. Enabling the movement towards advanced chip design, KLA's Global Products Group (GPG), which is responsible for creating all of KLA’s metrology and inspection products, is looking for the best and the brightest research scientist, software engineers, application development engineers, and senior product technology process engineers. The RAPID division is the world leading provider of reticle inspection solutions for the semiconductor industry. The company provides inspection solutions to both the mask shops and the semiconductor fabs to ensure that lithography yields are consistently high thus enabling cost-effective manufacturing.

- Lead engineering development projects for mask inspection products in RAPID division of KLA

- Assess, evaluate risks, and drive projects forward with an eye for critical path

- Communicate cross-functionally with a diverse team including engineering, marketing, manufacturing, and service to drive execution

- Lead, encourage, empower, and influence team members to achieve excellence in engineering rigor, reliability, usability, and customer focus

- Articulate and present execution plans for internal leadership as well as external customers

- Identify bottlenecks and remove obstacles for the team to focus on value-add activities

- Hold regular meetings between functional groups to ensure interdependencies are well understood and documented

- Support roadmap development by detailing upcoming requirement changes and resources required

You will be a phenomenal fit for our team if you like:

- To work with pioneering technology with meaningful impact on semiconductor industry

- To work with passionate people with a diverse set of backgrounds

- To build positive relationships, and develop new skills in a high-tech environment

- To take on sophisticated and ambitious projects and succeed in the marketplace

- Great teammate with strong leadership, critical thinking, communication and analytical skills

- Curiosity and disposition towards learning fast beyond immediate knowledge span

- Experience in Capital Equipment sectors is a plus (e.g. Semiconductors, Medical Equipment, Robotics)

- Experience with Project Management tools (MS Project, Wrike, Jira, etc)

- PMP or Agile certification is a plus
